avatar.label: Avatar

avatarLit.label: Avatar (lighting)
avatarLit.description: The avatar with normal maps, for trying the lights

dressUp.label: Dress-up

errors.wasmMissing: ugoe-wasm is not built (run `pnpm wasm` in apps/viewer).

file.not_model: {{path}} is not a model or a dress-up module (only .ugoe, .json and .ugoemod files can be opened)
file.too_large: {{path}} is too large to open ({{size}} bytes; the limit is {{max}} bytes)
file.not_json: {{path}} is not a JSON file (only .json files can be saved here)
file.not_png: {{path}} is not a PNG file (only .png files can be saved here)
file.not_chosen: {{path}} cannot be read because it was not chosen (open it from the dialog or drop it on the window)
file.not_chosen_for_save: {{path}} cannot be written because it was not chosen in the save dialog

request.not_png_data: The data to save is not a PNG image
request.missing_path: The path to save to was not given
request.invalid_path: The path to save to is invalid ({{reason}})

files.noPaths: This app cannot read files from paths.

skipped.some_one: Skipped {{count}} item that cannot be opened
skipped.some_other: Skipped {{count}} items that cannot be opened
skipped.extension: {{names}} (only models (.ugoe, .json) and dress-up modules (.ugoemod) can be opened, and the contents of folders are not opened)

preview.none: Nothing here can be opened (drop a model (.ugoe, .json) or a dress-up module (.ugoemod))
preview.some_one: Opens {{count}} file ({{skipped}} cannot be opened and will be skipped)
preview.some_other: Opens {{count}} files ({{skipped}} cannot be opened and will be skipped)
preview.later_one: {{count}} file is checked by its name when dropped
preview.later_other: {{count}} files are checked by their names when dropped
preview.skipTypes_one: Skips {{count}} file of a type that cannot be opened ({{later}})
preview.skipTypes_other: Skips {{count}} files of a type that cannot be opened ({{later}})

viewport.empty: Drop a model (.ugoe, model.json) here or choose a file to open. You can also try a sample.
viewport.gpuWaiting: Waiting for the GPU to be restored…

language.label: Language
language.description: The language of the viewer. Match the OS uses the language of the operating system (English if it is not supported).

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.noModel: Open a model to show its parameters

showInternal.description: Relay parameters pass values between physics rigs. You usually do not move them.

lighting.title: Lighting

markers.label: Show the light markers in the viewport

memory.none: Nothing remembered for this model yet

pad.aria: Direction the directional light comes from (the center is the front)
Position of the point light on the canvas

lighting.hint: Position, distance and range are ratios to the canvas (distance and range to its longer side).

toCenter.tooltip: The center of the canvas is off screen (in the direction of the arrow). The dial is moved to the edge of the screen.

directional.aria: Direction the directional light comes from (arrow keys move it, Shift for larger steps)
directional.tooltip: Directional light: the light comes from the side of the handle (center = front, edge = side). Drag it or use the arrow keys.

range.tooltip: Range of the point light: drag the edge to change it.

rangeGrip.tooltip: Range of the point light: its edge is off screen. Drag along the arrow to widen it, the other way to narrow it.

point.aria: Point light (arrow keys move it, Shift for larger steps; Page Up and Page Down change the distance, + and − the range)
point.tooltip: Point light: drag it or use the arrow keys. Shift + wheel, Page Up and Page Down change the distance; dragging the edge of the range circle, + and − change the range.
point.tooltipOffscreen: Point light (off screen, shown at the edge): drag it or use the arrow keys. Shift + wheel, Page Up and Page Down change the distance; dragging the edge of the range circle, + and − change the range.

memory.remembered: A set is remembered for this model

restore.title: This model had a set of modules attached before

hint.noModel: Open a model to attach modules
hint.noSlots: This model has no slots (it does not support dress-up)
hint.noPublishedSlots: This model does not expose any dress-up slots

badge.missingDescription: This model has no such slot, so these modules cannot be attached.
badge.hiddenDescription: A slot for the author of the model (its avatar profile does not expose it to apps), so these modules cannot be attached.

motions.title: Motions and expressions

trackingNote.motionWins: While tracking, the parameters that a played motion moves use the motion (except idle motions and the parts taken out of the preference). Expressions are added on top of the tracking.
trackingNote.trackingWins: While tracking, the tracking replaces the motion on the parameters it writes (head direction, eyes, mouth and so on). Expressions are added on top of the tracking.

groups.label: Prefer for
groups.description: Parts taken out stay with the tracking even when a motion moves them.

motions.eventsDescription: Newest first. Each event shows the motion that fired it and the number it was started with, so a restarted motion and the two motions of a crossfade can be told apart.

overlap.label: Adds to tracking
overlap.tooltip: Parameters added on top of the tracking: {{parameters}}

poses.title: Pose
poses.hint: Choose the part to show in each group (it fades in). While a motion switches the same group, the motion takes precedence and the choice follows it.

memory.title: Remembered for each model
memory.description: Lights, dress-up sets and idle motion choices are remembered for each model in this browser (app). Forgetting them does not change the current lights, the attached modules or the playing idle motion.
memory.kept: The last lights, the light markers, restoring the previous set and playing the idle motion automatically stay as they are.

forgetAll.label: Forget everything…
forgetAll.title: Forget everything?
forgetAll.description_one: Forgets everything remembered for {{count}} model. This cannot be undone.
forgetAll.description_other: Forgets everything remembered for {{count}} models. This cannot be undone.
